stories.title: POST /api/admin/articles must bind body.site_id (T13 PATCH tenant-guard unreachable for new articles)
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN POST /api/admin/articles with body {site_id:'<existing-site>', slug:'mqafix1', title:'T'}, WHEN GET /api/admin/articles/<id>, THEN response.site_id == '<existing-site>'.
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN POST /api/admin/articles with body {site_id:'<nonexistent-site>', slug:'x', title:'y'}, WHEN response received, THEN status=400 and error references unknown site.
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN POST creates A1 with (site_id=S1, slug='dup'), WHEN POST attempts (site_id=S1, slug='dup'), THEN response=409 SLUG_UNIQUENESS_VIOLATION.
